methods.name: Stage-Progression
methods.rationale: Applies typical Series C → next-stage step-up multiplier (1.7x) to $100M total raised proxy.

private.name: Meter
private.rationale: Same sector (Housing & Construction), same stage (Series C)

data.narrative:
ICON is a Series C–stage housing and construction company that has raised $450M+ to date. The valuation exercise draws from a comp universe of one identified private peer (Meter), with no public construction or housing technology companies included in the triangulation set.

A stage-progression methodology was applied, using total capital raised ($450M+) as a proxy baseline anchored to $100M. Applying a 1.7x multiplier typical for Series C to subsequent-stage progression yields an implied valuation of $170M. This represents the primary quantitative signal available given limited comp data. No additional triangulation methods (revenue multiple, DCF, or market-based approaches) were executable with the provided dataset.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $144M to $195M, with a median estimate of $170M. The narrow comp set—one private peer and zero public comparables—substantially constrains conviction in this range. Key uncertainties include unit economics, capital intensity relative to peers, near-term revenue trajectory, and the current market conditions for growth-stage construction technology. Additional data on ICON's revenue run-rate, gross margins, and a broader peer set would be required to meaningfully validate or adjust this estimate.
